title: When hot, reviews and trials launch first
description: With a fixture CPU temperature of 82C (60 s package average), the loop starts no new implementation session while a review and a queued trial launch, and master status shows the implementation hold; at 86C nothing new starts; below 80C implementation launches again; with free capacity and both kinds ready, reviews and trials launch before workers.

steps.name: at 82C implementation launches wait while a review launches, as master status shows
